ज्ञानम्.note: सुभाषितम् 13 (शिक्षा 7) — truth, penance, wisdom and conduct make a scholar, not study alone

जीवे.note: सुभाषितम् 15 (शिक्षा 8) — a hundred years, and almost none of it one’s own

जरायाः.note: सुभाषितम् 17 (शिक्षा 9) — everything in the world carries a fear; only renunciation carries none
